summary: Iter 216h58 — Brand Palette Extraction & Apply feature testing. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: Code review verified all required elements present (dropzone, palette swatches, drag-drop handlers, apply color function). UI automation limited by login redirect issue in browser automation.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND VERIFIED: POST /api/account/logo returns brand_palette (list of #RRGGBB hex strings) in addition to logo_url. Palette extraction uses Pillow MEDIANCUT quantization, filters near-white (max>=245 AND min>=235) and near-black (max<=25) pixels.
BACKEND VERIFIED: GET /api/account/organisation returns brand_palette (list) and primary_color (resolved via fallback chain: branding.primary_color → primary_brand_colour → brand_color).

BACKEND VERIFIED: POST /api/account/branding/apply writes to ALL THREE fields (branding.primary_color, primary_brand_colour, brand_color). Returns {primary_color: '#RRGGBB'}. Invalid hex returns 400 with 'primary_color must be a #RRGGBB hex string'.
BACKEND VERIFIED: POST /api/account/branding/apply with Staff role returns 403 'Only owners or managers can update brand colours'.

FRONTEND VERIFIED: OrganisationSection has drag-and-drop dropzone with data-testid='account-org-logo-dropzone'. Has dashed border, onDragOver/onDragLeave/onDrop handlers, dragOver state for highlight.

FRONTEND VERIFIED: Palette section with data-testid='account-org-palette' renders when brand_palette or primary_color exists. Each swatch has data-testid='account-org-palette-swatch-{lowerHexNoHash}'.
FRONTEND VERIFIED: Active swatch has ring-2 ring-offset-2 highlight. Clicking swatch calls applyBrandColor() which POSTs to /api/account/branding/apply.
FRONTEND VERIFIED: onLogoDrop handler validates file type, checks canEditLogo permission, calls uploadLogo() which fires POST /api/account/logo.

success_rate.frontend: Code review verified - UI automation limited by login redirect
